title: Createrington Currency
description: Custom currency mod that communicates with an external API.
body: Createrington Currency is a Minecraft mod for NeoForge 1.21.1 that adds a full-featured custom economy system to your server. All in-game currency data is managed by an external web backend rather than stored in the Minecraft world, enabling persistent and centralized account management across multiple servers or worlds This mod is ideal for server operators who want to integrate a Minecraft economy with their own web infrastructure. Players can earn, trade, deposit, and withdraw virtual money using physical currency items and chat commands, while the server owner’s backend handles the actual balances and transactions securely. The system is flexible and can be adapted by others through configuration – you can point the mod to your own API endpoints and use it with any custom economy server, as long as those endpoints follow the expected format.
